name: Twin rails, one hub: virtual J1 on a crown rail, virtual J3 on an arm rail
family: spherical 3R (virtual J1 / J3 on arc rails)
verdict: dead (gate converged): best honest 91.97 (score 66.6) vs the spherical champion 68.93 and the verified leaders 64.7 / 66.47; the rails replace the pole hubs, which were never the limiter (they sit 98-100 % in band as O20 hubs), and add their own: a constant-section rail must clear the highest skin anywhere on its 120-190 deg arc in any pose (crown rail 0.0006 in band), the arm rail must span the humeral rotation range (cov 1.0 needs 420 deg) and collapses into a ring bearing round a lateral humeral pole; J2 and link 2 stay at 0 % in band. Even the shaped crown rail (cam + uncharged radial float) only reaches 97.64 at the coarse leader's axes.
note: Bench(60,160), fast grid, K3 march, K2 dense, K6 (same-body / rolling-joint pairs exempt), audit clean, rails laid out at their fitted radius (fix point). 1510 configs in order: 166 coarse (farm) + 3 local + 1 variant-b bound + CMA-ES streams A 1105 / B 81 / C 97 / D 57 (farm, tools/concept_cma.py, popsize 8; B-D never honest: link 2 floats > 140 mm). Gate (variant a, score points, 1509 tries): gain over 2nd half 0.10, last third 0.02, top-5 spread 0.01 - CONVERGED (stream A's basin). Kinematics: 95 %-central carriage travels sum >= ~300 deg over 1640 valid axis sets (spec hoped +-35). Raw maps: 8 % of axis sets have a crown rail clear of the body; best constant-section crown rail 0.49 in band. Best k1091: crown rail about bvec(97.7, 65.3) at cone 31.2 deg, J2 at a12 53.4, arm rail a ring of cone 11.2 deg about wdir(49.0, -28.8), a23 88.8, cov 0.966, shoe 24 mm.
limiter: crown rail constant section: rows sit far above the median skin along its arc (set where the elevated arm passes under the S-fixed arc, elev 165), 0.0006 in band; hub 2 0.0009 and link 2 0.0002 in band (J2 floats over the deltoid as in the spherical family); arm rail span (humeral rotation + shoe) caps reach at 0.74 even at cov 0.97; in-band 14 0.137 total, carried by the carriage lips and the neck

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R whose two pole joints are arc rails (virtual axes), J2 the only hub. bodies: link 1 (carriage 1 + bridge), link 2 (strap + carriage 3), arm-end (arm rail + K7 neck). joints: J1 carriage 1 on the crown rail, J3 carriage 3 on the arm rail (caged-ball wire-race C-slides; the cages run at half speed, set by the carriages, not counted as bodies), J2 O20 hub. custom: crown rail (base), carriage 1, bridge, link 2, carriage 3, arm rail, neck, 2 ball cages, J2 shaft (est.); catalogue: MR117 pair, 8 race wires, 2 ball sets (est.).
